selected_evidence.requirement: Local repository built and served from local storage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: tree RPM downloaded into /srv/localrepo, createrepo generated metadata, httpd started and served repodata/repomd.xml with HTTP 200 from http://$NODE_IP/localrepo/

selected_evidence.requirement: Remote repositories made unreachable, local repo remained reachable
selected_evidence.summary: iptables OUTPUT rules block remote 80/443 destinations; verification shows remote vault.centos.org fetch fails (curl exit 7 / connection refused) while local repo returns HTTP 200

selected_evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repository while remotes unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: yum install restricted to --enablerepo=local-repo succeeded installing tree-1.6.0-10.el7.x86_64; rpm -q and yum list installed confirm package present, sourced from @local-repo

selected_evidence.requirement: Remote reachability restored after test (reversible disruption)
selected_evidence.summary: iptables rules removed; OUTPUT chain returned to default ACCEPT-all; remote vault.centos.org URL returns HTTP 200 again

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 3dba43a5-f3bc-4eb9-90a0-cacb0623feda, httpd active/enabled, local repo HTTP 200, tree package present

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Detached backgrounded 'sleep 2 && reboot' command returned 'reboot scheduled' acknowledgement immediately, before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed after restart (proof of actual reboot)
selected_evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (SSH connection timed out) during reboot, then came back with new boot_id 9a21a3eb-0760-45a7-8d5b-506440928818, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, and new uptime

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required services, data, and connectivity
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot checks confirm httpd active+enabled, local repo still serving HTTP 200, tree package still installed, local.repo config intact, iptables rules clean (no leftover blocks), and remote mirror reachable again (HTTP 200)
